text: MECHATRONICS It is Japanese-English word. It is a field of science that combines "MECHANICS" and "ELECTRONICS".

title: Introduction to Mechatronics
text: IN THE OLD DAYS Machine from the past run only with a driving motor when it is plugged and powered on. Nowadays, most machines are mechatronics. • Fan, cleaner • TV, recorder • ･･･ The electronic control is the basis for recent machines operations.

title: Introduction to Mechatronics
text: THE APPLICATION RANGE The application range is quite huge. • Vehicles (cars, trains, airplanes) • Robots (production line) • Home electronics • Infrastructure (ETC, parking gate) • Housing • ･･･ It applies to machines AUTOMATION.

title: Introduction to Mechatronics
text: AUTOMATIC CONTROL To make a machine operate correctly toward target settings, we should CHECK machine’s state/condition by using SENSORS data (location, acceleration, power and so on). The power of ACTUATORS (engine, motor, display, speaker and so on), which DRIVE the machine, has to be regulated on the basis of this state information.

title: Introduction to Mechatronics
text: "MACHINE" AND "ELECTRON" Integrating both elements can build high quality mechatronics machines. • Mechanical system • good at: lifting heavy weights with great force • not good at: moving delicately. • Electronic system • good at: delicate control by sensor & MCU. • not good at: lift heavy weight by itself MCU ： Micro Controller Unit

title: Introduction to Mechatronics
text: "MECHANISM" AND "MACHINE ELEMENT" • Mechanism • structure to fulfill the desired motion with another part's motion. • Machine Element • “Smallest” part of a machine • Cannot be decomposed into smaller pieces • bolts, nuts, cogwheels, shaft , bearings, and so on.

title: Introduction to Mechatronics
text: SENSOR 1. Takes the measurement object's reaction 2. translates it into the PHYSICAL QUANTITY that we can use. • Role of sensor • Measure the state/condition of • environment, mechanism, motion, or actuation • Convert it into an • electric signal • Pass it to the CPU.

title: Introduction to Mechatronics
text: ACTUATOR Mechanism that puts something into automatic action • Definition/Role of actuator A) Translates the inputted energy into physical motion ⇒ ○○ motor B) Something that operates or drives actively ⇒ light, vibration, heat, etc.

title: Introduction to Mechatronics
text: ELECTRICAL AND ELECTRONIC ENGINEERING Electrical Engineering : Electricity as a power supplier (electric power) for appliances. Also called power electrics. Electronic Engineering : Mainly transmits electric signal and controls some machine by using the electric signal. Also called weak electrics. In mechatronics system, we treat the electric wire that supplies electricity for operations as power electric wire and the wire that transmits signal as weak electric wire.

title: Introduction to Mechatronics
text: COMPUTER Overview of the role of computer • The role of computer is to • translate • the input  electronic signal from the sensors  Keyboard, mouse, distance, temperature… into • the output  electric signal to run the actuators  Display, sound, motor, fan…

title: Introduction to Mechatronics
text: PROGRAM AND MECHATRONICS since 2013 Aoyama Gakuin University - Guillaume Lopez 28 Most home appliances that use electronic/electrical technology have a built-in computer system called a micro-controller unit (MCU). The MCU is connected to sensors and actuators to form an embedded system that controls operations. A software engineer is mainly in charge of work about embedded system.

title: Introduction to Mechatronics
text: SIGNAL PROCESSING AND MECHATRONICS • To operate safely and smoothly, the whole system should 1. be supervised constantly so that occurrences of failure or exception can be detected. 2.
